# Aahil Afraz

> Software engineer and designer in Philadelphia. Starting at Zaro Health (https://zarohealth.com/). Previously a software engineering co-op on Comcast's DevSecOps team. NASA Space Apps 2025 Global Nominee (top 1,290 of 11,500+ projects). Co-founder of LearnFlow (150+ beta users). Also a photographer and the musician Azrael.

## Projects

- [AirCast](https://aahilafraz.com/work/aircast): Named a NASA Space Apps Global Nominee (top 1,290 of 11,500+ projects).
- [Security Analytics Platform](https://aahilafraz.com/work/security-analytics): One view of an organization's security posture for engineering leaders, with an agent that summarizes it.
- [LearnFlow](https://aahilafraz.com/work/learnflow): An AI study app I co-founded and built. 150+ beta users.
- [StockAnalyzer](https://aahilafraz.com/work/stock-analyzer): Enter a stock ticker and get a research report in seconds.
- [Transcriber](https://aahilafraz.com/work/transcriber): A transcription app that runs entirely on your Mac. No audio is uploaded.
- [Angular → React migration](https://aahilafraz.com/work/enable-games): Moved a production game portal from Angular to React. First load 35% faster.
- [PhillyFeelSafe](https://aahilafraz.com/work/phillyfeelsafe): An interactive safety map of Philadelphia, built by a four-person team.
